ITA-9.2.81 siddhabastiḥ सिद्धबस्तिः
Enema for strength, complexion and growth
A type of specially medicated enema which can cure certain diseases and boost longevity.

ITA-1.7.1 siddhāntaḥ सिद्धान्तः
Theory
An established theory that has been critically examined and accepted by qualified investigators. It may be common to all schools of thought, scripture and branches of science (sarvatantrasiddhantaḥ) or particular to any one of them (pratitantrasiddhantaḥ).
